title: Richer by 1800?
hook: Before industry, did people at least get slowly richer? Test north and central Italy.

knows: income per person rises over time
doesNotKnow: that on the best reconstruction, north and central Italy were poorer per person in 1800 than in 1450

misconception: Income per person only ever rose, even if slowly, before industry.
objective: The learner can say that on Maddison's series, income per person in north and central Italy fell to an index of about 75 in 1800 (1450 = 100), about 0.08% a year for 350 years, so income per person can shrink for centuries.

claims.text: Maddison's series of income per person for north and central Italy, each year from 1310 to 1871, shown as an index with 1450 = 100.
claims.source: history-data.mjs: maddison, maddison2020.csv, Entity 'Italy', column 'GDP per capita', 1310-1871 (562 values, none missing; copied into Demo.tsx unchanged). Maddison README (opened by cm-history): Italy 1310-1871 (North Italy), Malanima (2010). history-cycle2-check.mjs section 18.

claims.text: In 1800 the index was about 75: a person in north and central Italy had about 75% of the income of one in 1450.
claims.source: 100 x 2,404 / 3,218 = 74.7, rounded to 75. history-cycle2-check.mjs section 18 '18 1450 and 1800'.

claims.text: That is a fall of about 0.08% a year for 350 years.

claims.source: 100 x g / g(1450) for 1310 and 1871, rounded (1310 89 is in the script's output; 1871 computed the same way in Demo.tsx).

claims.text: Income per person can shrink for centuries, not only grow.
claims.source: Follows from c2 and c3 on this series (one reconstruction; see c6).

claims.text: Where it stops: this is one reconstruction, it covers only the north and centre before 1871, and the copy we opened states no unit, so it is read as an index.
claims.source: Maddison README (opened by cm-history): one source named for 1310-1871 (Malanima 2010, North Italy), Baffigi (2011) from 1871; the OWID copy's columns state no currency unit (history-data.mjs: maddison 'what'). history-cycle2-check.mjs section 18 '18 north and centre only before 1871'.

recall.question: A town's income per person falls 0.1% a year for 300 years. About how much poorer is it at the end?
recall.why: 0.999 to the power 300 is about 0.74: a fall too slow to notice in a lifetime adds up to about a quarter over centuries.
